system.description:
Use an Interact Action to make a Smarts Check against a target enemy's CR. On a success the Director reveals one of its Weaknesses; a Critical Success may reveal several.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.45
system.summary: Use an Interact Action to make a Smarts Check against a target enemy's CR. On a success the Director reveals one of its Weaknesses; a Critical Success may reveal several.

automation.onSuccess: The Director reveals one of the target's Weaknesses (several on a Critical Success).

automation.note: Set the CR in the roll dialog to the target enemy's CR. On a success the Director reveals one Weakness (maybe more on a Critical Success).
